appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` presenter-policy guidance to reflect that scene presentation is now the default startup path, with frame presentation reserved for explicit debug mode and same-session fallback.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: On native Windows missions, the startup procedure should treat `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .factory/windows-swift-env.ps1 -CheckOnly` as the first-class environment check when `.factory/init.sh` is a bash wrapper, instead of assuming the shell can execute bash/WSL scripts directly.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `fix-win32host-string-decoding-warning` review found that `.factory/init.sh` is bash-only while this mission runs on Windows, and the recorded handoff for worker session `37a1b476-5180-4f15-8c04-2999a22c8216` shows the worker had to deviate from the skill and call `windows-swift-env.ps1 -CheckOnly` directly.
